question: PROVISIONAL: Can a time-causal, evidence-grounded forecaster improve proper-scoring loss over a matched Kalshi market-implied forecast on settled H100 weekly and monthly markets?
hypothesis: PROVISIONAL: An auditable forecast-score-diagnose-revise loop using cutoff-bounded Exa evidence and explicit economic features will reduce out-of-sample proper-scoring loss versus the contemporaneous Kalshi baseline.
primary_metric: PROVISIONAL: paired delta in Brier score versus the time-matched Kalshi probability, with calibration and log loss as secondary metrics
baseline: PROVISIONAL: Kalshi market-implied probability captured at the same forecast timestamp and before the market cutoff

dataset.name: Settled Kalshi H100 weekly and monthly markets
dataset.cutoff: per-market cutoff or close; exact timestamp policy pending review
